✓ Crown Estate Scotland.question: It is overseen by a non-executive board whose members and chair are appointed by _____
✓ Crown Estate Scotland.fact: As such Scottish Ministers are ultimately accountable for Crown Estate Scotland and the Scottish Crown Estate. It is overseen by a non-executive board whose members and chair are appointed by Scottish Ministers.

✓ Crown Estate Scotland.subject: World Geography
✓ Crown Estate Scotland.question: The board appoints a _____, who is responsible for day-to-day running of the organisation and is accountable to both the Scottish Parliament and the Board
✓ Crown Estate Scotland.fact: The board appoints a Chief Executive, who is responsible for day-to-day running of the organisation and is accountable to both the Scottish Parliament and the Board. As of September 2022 the Chief Executive was Ronan O'Hara.
